commentary_title: Fr vessel congestion eases as tonne-mile demand moderates
commentary_summary: Ballast tonnage at anchor declined sharply in the Indian Ocean and Atlantic, but remained above levels seen during the same period in 2024 and 2025. | Laden tonnage at anchor in the Atlantic has fallen sharply over the past month, dropping below comparable levels in both 2024 and 2025. | Global ballast speed increased over the past two weeks, but remained below 2025 levels, broadly continuing the trend seen through much of 2026. | The tonne-mile index declined last week after rising through much of the past month, returning to levels broadly in line with the same period in 2025
